VE-06.plain: This formula gives the chance that independent random checks find one forged segment: 1 − ((N−1)/N)^M. Only the project has checked.
VE-06.developer: P(detect) = 1 − ((N−1)/N)^M; one checker doing k distinct segments: k/N.

VE-07.plain: With {total} segments, {m95} independent random checks would find one forged segment 95% of the time. Only the project has checked.
VE-07.developer: Smallest M with p≥0.95 at N={total} is {m95} (p=0.95090).

VE-08.plain: With {m99} independent random checks, the chance would be 99%. Only the project has checked.
VE-08.developer: Smallest M with p≥0.99 at N={total} is {m99} (p=0.99025).
